correctness.rationale: For distinct nonzero residues a,b the conjugate difference is the usual root difference times (1−cζ^{−a−b}); an integer collision coefficient at odd conductor can only be 1. For c≠1 the element is integral of full degree, and the absolute Vandermonde quotient is the index since Z[ζ] is the full integer ring. For pair sum zero every nonzero a pairs with −a and no diagonal occurs; for nonzero sum t, omit a=0,t,t/2 and divide by two. The nonzero-sum product is (1−c^p)/(1−c), giving the stated formula. For p=3 the zero exponent permits c=2; for p≥5 it excludes c=2. At c=1 the field is the maximal real subfield, not a full-rank order. Independent replay /workspace/branches/review_replay_3.py constructed powers in the integral ζ basis and checked 70 exact determinants; this is corroboration, not the general proof.
